an6.46:1.2: The Cetīs were a people living in the Bundelkhand division of Madhya Pradesh, south of Vaccha and west of Magadha. Their capital was on the Vettavatī river (Sanskrit _vetravatī_, modern Betwa), a tributary of the Yamunā flowing from the Vindhya ranges to the south. Apart from three discourses featuring Mahācunda there, only other other is recorded ([sn56.30]()). The spelling of the city is highly uncertain: _sayaṁjāti_, _sahajāti_, _sañjāti_, _sahañcanika_, _sahajaniya_.
an6.46:2.1: See my essay on these terms and the interpretation of this sutta: https://discourse.suttacentral.net/t/was-there-a-conflict-between-scholars-and-meditators/2676
